user.title: Create Energy Report
user.description: Choose a name and source strategy.

sources.title: Consumption sources
sources.description: Only native energy and power sensors with compatible metadata are accepted.

reporting.title: Cost and reporting
reporting.description: Choose one notification entity. A notification group can be selected as a single destination.

test_notification.title: Test notification
test_notification.description: Optionally send a test before creating the integration.

reconfigure.title: Replace sources
reconfigure.description: The ledger is preserved and the new source starts from a fresh baseline.

error.invalid_energy_sensor: Select a sensor with energy device class and Wh, kWh or MWh unit.
error.invalid_power_sensor: Select a sensor with power device class and W, kW or MW unit.

abort.already_configured: An instance with this name already exists.

import_history.title: Import CSV history
import_history.description: Target instance: {instance_name} ({instance_id}). Choose a CSV from this device. Only this instance's isolated ledger can be changed, after validation and confirmation.

confirm_import.title: Confirm history import
confirm_import.description: Target instance: {instance_name} ({instance_id}). File: {filename}. Closed: {closed_count}; open: {open_count}; new: {new_count}; already identical: {identical_count}; current-month conflicts: {current_conflict_count}; safe merge: {merge_status}. Closed conflicts are never overwritten. A merge is offered only when snapshot_at proves that CSV history ends before native collection began.

export_history.title: Export CSV history
export_history.description: Target instance: {instance_name} ({instance_id}). Choose the current or previous year.

export_ready.title: CSV export ready
export_ready.description: Instance: {instance_name} ({instance_id}); year: {year}. [Download CSV]({download_url}). The authenticated download regenerates the file from the current ledger.

review_anomalies.title: Review consumption anomalies
review_anomalies.description: Select an unresolved event. Legacy aggregates are identified when original details are unavailable.

confirm_anomaly.title: Review anomaly
confirm_anomaly.description: Month: {month}. Detected: {detected_at}. Source: {source}. Previous/new reading: {previous}/{new} kWh. Interval: {interval} minutes. Excluded increment: {excluded} kWh. Plausible limit: {limit} kWh. Reason: {reason}. Estimated impact: {cost} {currency}. Accepting adds it to consumption; confirming exclusion keeps it out and closes the review.

error.history_import_invalid: The CSV is invalid or does not match a supported schema.
error.history_invalid_headers: The CSV columns do not match the documented Energy Report schema.
error.history_closed_month_conflict: A closed month differs from the existing ledger. Closed months are never overwritten.
error.history_open_month_not_current: An open CSV record must refer to the current Home Assistant month.
error.anomaly_review_failed: The anomaly could not be reviewed. Reload the flow and try again.

abort.missing_import_preview: The import preview is no longer available.
abort.invalid_export_year: Only the current and previous year can be exported.
abort.missing_export_selection: The export selection is no longer available.
abort.no_pending_anomalies: There are no consumption anomalies awaiting review.
abort.anomaly_not_found: The selected anomaly is no longer available.

options.accept_increment: Accept increment and include it in consumption

options.keep_native: Keep data collected by Energy Report
options.merge_non_overlapping: Merge CSV history with later Energy Report data
